function.arguments: {"finding": "The 'treatment' arm has a much higher proportion of severe cases (95 out of 253, ~37.6%) compared to the 'control' arm (21 out of 459, ~4.6%).", "implication": "This is a critical confounding factor. Since severity is a strong predictor of response (sicker patients are less likely to respond), and the treatment arm is systematically sicker, any raw comparison of response rates between arms will be misleading. The treatment arm may appear worse, even if the drug is effective, because the patients are sicker. Therefore, we must adjust for severity — either by stratifying or using a model — rather than reporting the raw difference. The contract does not require adjustment, but Rule 4 says: 'Before comparing any two groups, check that they are comparable.' The groups are not comparable. The raw difference would be invalid."}
function.name: note_finding
